```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Read the results for the specified comparisons
d1_spn <- read_excel("D1-SPN DEGs between 16p males vs wt females subset_fold_changes.xlsx")
d2_spn <- read_excel("D2-SPN DEGs between 16p males vs wt females subset_fold_changes.xlsx")
```

```{r}
d1_spn_filt <- d1_spn %>%
  filter(log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale <= -0.2 | log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale >= 0.2)

ggplot(d1_spn_filt, aes(x = log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale, y = log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x = -4, label.y = 4) +
  labs(title = "D1-SPN DEGs between 16p males vs wt females - method = pearson",
       x = "Pseudobulk log2 fold change (hetmale vs WTmale)",
       y = "Pseudobulk log2 fold change (WTfemale vs WTmale)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

quad_counts <- d1_spn_filt %>%
  mutate(quadrant = case_when(
    log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale >= 0 & log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale >= 0 ~ "Q1: x+, y+",
    log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale <  0 & log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale >= 0 ~ "Q2: x-, y+",
    log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale <  0 & log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale <  0 ~ "Q3: x-, y-",
    log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale >= 0 & log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale <  0 ~ "Q4: x+, y-"
  )) %>%
  count(quadrant) %>%
  arrange(quadrant)

print(quad_counts)
```

```{r}
# 1) exclude sex-driven genes + filter |x| >= 0.2 on x-axis (hetmale vs WTmale)
d1_spn_filtered <- d1_spn %>%
  filter(!gene %in% c("Rnf121", "Gm26825", "Tmem181a", "Zc3h11a")) %>%
  filter(log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale <= -0.2 | log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale >= 0.2)

# 2) thresholds for labeling (match plot axes!)
x_high <-  2.0   # for x = log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale
x_low  <- -2.0
y_high <-  0.5   # for y = log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale
y_low  <- -0.8

# 3) choose points to label using the SAME column names as the plot
lab_df <- d1_spn_filtered %>%
  filter(log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale >  x_high |
         log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale <  x_low  |
         log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale > y_high |
         log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale < y_low)

# 4) plot
ggplot(d1_spn_filtered,
       aes(x = log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale, y = log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = Inf, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
  labs(
    title = "D1-SPN DEGs between 16p males vs wt females - Pearson - outliers excluded",
    x = "Pseudobulk log2 fold change (hetmale vs WTmale)",
    y = "Pseudobulk log2 fold change (WTfemale vs WTmale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(size = 12))

ggplot(d1_spn_filtered, aes(x = log2FC_hetmale_vs_WTmale, y = log2FC_WTfemale_vs_WTmale)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = Inf) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
  labs(title = "D1-SPN DEGs between 16p males vs wt females - method = spearman - outlayers excluded",
       x = "Pseudobulk log2 fold change (hetmale vs WTmale)",
       y = "Pseudobulk log2 fold change (WTfemale vs WTmale)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r}
bulk_16pfemales <- read_excel("BulkRNAseqDGEs16pfemales.xlsx")
bulk_16pmales <- read_excel("BulkRNAseqDGEs16pmales.xlsx")
WTmalesfemales <- read_excel("DGEanalysis_RUV2_3gWTmalesVS3gWTfemales.xlsx")
```

```{r}
## --- Build merged df (already filtered for FDR etc.)
bulk <- bulk_16pmales %>%
  rename(gene = matches("(?i)^gene\\s*name$"),
         FDR_bulk   = FDR) %>%
  filter(FDR_bulk < 0.05, !gene %in% c("Tyr","Kdm5d"))%>%
  filter(logFC <= -0.2 | logFC >= 0.2)

wtmf <- WTmalesfemales %>%
  rename(gene = matches("(?i)^gene\\s*name$"),
         logFC_wtmf = logFC) %>%
  filter(!gene %in% c("Tyr"))

df <- inner_join(
  wtmf %>% select(gene, logFC_wtmf),
  bulk %>% select(gene, logFC),
  by = "gene"
)

## --- Select genes to label by your thresholds
lab_df <- df %>%
  filter(logFC > 2 | logFC < -1.5 |
         logFC_wtmf > 0.4 | logFC_wtmf < -0.4)

## --- Plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC, y = logFC_wtmf)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = Inf) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x = min(df$logFC) + 5, label.y = max(df$logFC_wtmf) - 1) +
  labs(
    title = "mRNA-seq DEGs between 16p males vs wt males",
    x = "Fold Change from 16p male mutant vs 16p female WT",
    y = "Fold Change from 16p female WT vs 16p male WT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())



quad_counts <- df %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = case_when(
      logFC_wtmf >= 0 & logFC >= 0 ~ "Q1: x+, y+",
      logFC_wtmf <  0 & logFC >= 0 ~ "Q2: x-, y+",
      logFC_wtmf <  0 & logFC <  0 ~ "Q3: x-, y-",
      logFC_wtmf >= 0 & logFC <  0 ~ "Q4: x+, y-"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(quadrant)

quad_counts

quad_candidates <- df %>%
  filter(logFC > 0 & logFC_wtmf > 0) %>%   # upper-right quadrant
  pull(gene)
```

```{r}
# --- FEMALE DEL vs WT FEMALE: use the UNFILTERED table for the primary test
bulk_female_all <- bulk_16pfemales %>%
  rename(gene = matches("(?i)^gene\\s*name$"),
         logFC_female = logFC)

# (A) PRIMARY: bring all candidates into female comparison (no DEG filter)
candidate_effects_all <- tibble(gene = quad_candidates) %>%
  left_join(bulk_female_all %>% select(gene, logFC_female), by = "gene") %>%
  filter(is.finite(logFC_female)) %>%   # drop genes missing in female table
  mutate(direction = as.integer(logFC_female > 0))

n_A <- nrow(candidate_effects_all)
k_A <- sum(candidate_effects_all$direction)
bt_A <- binom.test(k_A, n_A, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")

cat(sprintf("[PRIMARY] Positives: %d/%d (%.1f%%)  p=%.4g\n",
            k_A, n_A, 100*k_A/n_A, bt_A$p.value))

# --- (B) SECONDARY/SENSITIVITY: restrict to significant female DEGs (your filtered bulk)
bulk_female_sig <- bulk_16pfemales %>%
  rename(gene = matches("(?i)^gene\\s*name$"),
         logFC_female = logFC,
         FDR_bulk     = FDR) %>%
  filter(FDR_bulk < 0.05, !gene %in% c("Tyr","Kdm5d")) %>%
  filter(logFC_female <= -0.2 | logFC_female >= 0.2)

candidate_effects_sig <- tibble(gene = quad_candidates) %>%
  inner_join(bulk_female_sig %>% select(gene, logFC_female), by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(direction = as.integer(logFC_female > 0))

n_B <- nrow(candidate_effects_sig)
k_B <- sum(candidate_effects_sig$direction)
if (n_B > 0) {
  bt_B <- binom.test(k_B, n_B, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")
  cat(sprintf("[SENSITIVITY] Positives: %d/%d (%.1f%%)  p=%.4g\n",
              k_B, n_B, ifelse(n_B>0, 100*k_B/n_B, NA), bt_B$p.value))
} else {
  cat("[SENSITIVITY] No candidates passed female DEG filters (n_B = 0)\n")
}
```

```{r}
k <- sum(candidate_effects$direction)
n <- nrow(candidate_effects)

# binomial test: H0 = 50% positive
bt <- binom.test(k, n, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")

cat("Positives:", k, "out of", n, "\n")
print(bt)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)

# --- Read data (3 columns: gene, x, y)
df <- read_table(
  file = "dSPNsDelSexComparison.txt",
  col_names = c("gene","x","y"),
  col_types = cols(
    gene = col_character(),
    x    = col_double(),
    y    = col_double()
  )
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y))

# --- Set thresholds for labeling
x_high <-  0.8    # label if x > 0.3
x_low  <- -0.75    # label if x < -0.3
y_high <-  0.75    # label if y > 2
y_low  <- -0.5    # label if y < -1.5

# Genes that meet thresholds
lab_df <- df %>%
  filter(x > x_high | x < x_low | y > y_high | y < y_low)

# --- Pearson correlation
ct <- cor.test(df$x, df$y, method = "pearson")
cat(sprintf("Pearson r = %.3f, p = %.3g\n", ct$estimate, ct$p.value))

# --- Quadrant counts
quad_counts <- df %>%
  mutate(quadrant = case_when(
    x >= 0 & y >= 0 ~ "Q1: x+, y+",
    x <  0 & y >= 0 ~ "Q2: x-, y+",
    x <  0 & y <  0 ~ "Q3: x-, y-",
    x >= 0 & y <  0 ~ "Q4: x+, y-"
  )) %>%
  count(quadrant) %>%
  arrange(quadrant)

print(quad_counts)

# --- Plot with labels for thresholded genes
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = Inf) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
  labs(
    title = "D1-SPN DEGs between 16p males vs wt females",
    x = "Fold Change from D1-SPNs males 16p11 vs males WT",
    y = "Fold Change from D1-SPNs females WT vs males WT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

```

```{r}
x_low  <- -0.75    # label if x < -0.3
y_high <-  0.75    # label if y > 2
y_low  <- -0.5    # label if y < -1.5

# Genes that meet thresholds
lab_df <- df %>%
  filter(x > x_high | x < x_low | y > y_high | y < y_low)

# --- Pearson correlation
ct <- cor.test(df$x, df$y, method = "pearson")
cat(sprintf("Pearson r = %.3f, p = %.3g\n", ct$estimate, ct$p.value))

# --- Quadrant counts
quad_counts <- df %>%
  mutate(quadrant = case_when(
    x >= 0 & y >= 0 ~ "Q1: x+, y+",
    x <  0 & y >= 0 ~ "Q2: x-, y+",
    x <  0 & y <  0 ~ "Q3: x-, y-",
    x >= 0 & y <  0 ~ "Q4: x+, y-"
  )) %>%
  count(quadrant) %>%
  arrange(quadrant)

print(quad_counts)

# --- Plot with labels for thresholded genes
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = Inf) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
  labs(
    title = "D2-SPN DEGs between 16p females vs wt females",
    x = "Fold Change from D2-SPNs females 16p11 vs males WT",
    y = "Fold Change from D2-SPNs females WT vs males WT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

```
